description: RailCloud-HdF: A Large-Scale Point Cloud Dataset for Railway Scene Semantic Segmentation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mahdi Abid, Mathis Teixeira (FCS Railenium). RailCloud-HdF is a large-scale LiDAR point-cloud dataset for railway scene semantic segmentation. It was introduced in the VISAPP 2024 paper “RailCloud-HdF: A Large-Scale Point Cloud Dataset for Railway Scene Semantic Segmentation” by Mahdi Abid, Mathis Teixeira, Ankur Mahtani, and Thomas Laurent. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
